title: ETHGlobal Mumbai
description: ETHGlobal's in-person hackathon in Mumbai. Hackers are accepted individually, stake a small amount of ETH (returned after submitting), build in teams of up to 5 and submit through the Hacker Dashboard. The prizes page lists 12 partner prizes of up to $15,000 each.
reward: Partner prizes up to $15,000 each; 12 prizes listed, 5 without details yet
summary: up to $15K per partner prize · in person · submit by Nov 7, 9:00 AM IST
setup: apply to attend by Nov 3 and get accepted
stake a small amount of ETH
rules: Submissions are due Saturday, November 7, 2026 at 9:00 AM IST, through the Hacker Dashboard. Late submissions are not accepted.
Classic track: all project work must begin after the hackathon starts. Projects built before the event may still take part but don't qualify for partner prizes or the Finalist category.

Continuity tracks (Extend Open Source, Ship a Feature): you may build on an existing codebase; document the pre-existing work and add new features built during the hackathon. Partner prize eligibility may vary by partner.
Use version control: large single commits or missing histories may be disqualified.
AI tools are allowed: document where and how they were used; projects built entirely by AI may not be eligible for partner prizes or finalist consideration.
Select up to 3 partner prizes on the last step of the submission form.

Per https://ethglobal.com/events/mumbai/info/start: each team member must be accepted and stake ETH individually; teams of up to 5; the stake is returned within about 4 weeks after the event to hackers who submitted a project.
Per ETHGlobal's events listing, the hackathon runs November 5 to 7, 2026 in Mumbai and hacker applications close November 3 at 11:59 PM IST.

submission_requirements.label: Link to your repository
submission_requirements.description: A GitHub repo, Figma files or equivalent, proving the work was done during the hackathon; say what is new and what is reused.

submission_requirements.label: Demo video
submission_requirements.description: Optional but strongly encouraged: 2 to 4 minutes, at least 720p, no sped-up footage, no AI voiceover.
